name: example-org
description: Example overlay: house rules and an internal knowledge base. Copy to repos/<owner>.json (public) or to ~/.config/pr-visual-map/profiles/repos/<owner>.json (private) and adapt.

sources.name: Team knowledge base
sources.search: grep folder names for the ticket id; search notes for class names.
rules: Read the repo's folder first (current facts), then the ticket folder (decisions, why).
When the knowledge base and the code disagree, the code wins: say so in the readme notes.
